{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Drop QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
sales = sales[sales['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Filter for completed orders
completed_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute average revenue per completed order in each channel
avg_revenue_email = completed_orders[completed_orders['channel'] == 'email']['revenue'].mean()
avg_revenue_paid_search = completed_orders[completed_orders['channel'] == 'paid_search']['revenue'].mean()

# Compute the difference
revenue_difference = avg_revenue_email - avg_revenue_paid_search

# Display results
print(f'Average revenue (email): {avg_revenue_email:.2f}')
print(f'Average revenue (paid_search): {avg_revenue_paid_search:.2f}')
print(f'Difference (email - paid_search): {revenue_difference:.2f}')"}
